dataList.content:
Haah... now let us converse for a moment.
呼……那么，让我们来谈谈吧。
dataList.title:
Blade Lineage
剑契组

dataList.content:
Aeng-du seemed to have recovered somewhat as we fought. She bound Jun with a rope before throwing him to the ground.
在我们战斗的时候，樱桃似乎恢复了一些，她把副会长用绳子捆了起来，往地上一扔，同时说道。

dataList.title:
Kurokumo Clan Captain
黑云会 副会长
dataList.content:
Agh...
咕……

dataList.title:
Blade Lineage
剑契组
dataList.content:
I do not expect a mere Captain to know why your organization has put a bounty on our heads.
我并不认为区区一个副会长会知道悬赏我们首级的理由。

dataList.title:
Blade Lineage
剑契组
dataList.content:
But... I cannot quite place the reason you were standing guard before this room. It was as though you were protecting our mentor from us, of all people.
但是……我不明白你看守着头领所在之处的原因，简直就像是在保护他一样。

dataList.title:
Blade Lineage
剑契组
dataList.content:
Wait, it wasn't just you, was it? Every Kurokumo Clan filth we killed on our way up to this floor stood in our path like they were protecting something with their lives.
不仅是你。这座建筑物里所有黑云会的家伙们……全都在拼命阻止我们往上走，惹人生厌。

dataList.title:
Kurokumo Clan Captain
黑云会 副会长
dataList.content:
Fine. Here's the truth, then.
不，我的意思是……

dataList.title:
Kurokumo Clan Captain
黑云会 副会长
dataList.content:
... We're the victims here.
我们才是受害者。

dataList.title:
Blade Lineage
剑契组
dataList.content:
...? Whatever do you mean?
……？你什么意思？

dataList.title:
Kurokumo Clan Captain
黑云会 副会长
dataList.content:
You guys really have a way of pushing my buttons, huh...
真是令人恼火……

dataList.title:
Kurokumo Clan Captain
黑云会 副会长
dataList.content:
Haah... we weren't part of the party pursuing you or cutting you down. That was none of my business.
哈啊……我们本来就和追杀你们这群家伙的工作没有关系。

dataList.title:
Kurokumo Clan Captain
黑云会 副会长
dataList.content:
You're just one of many, many Syndicates or organizations that were unlucky enough to be on the Thumb's shit list. Our run-in was just a coincidence.
被拇指通缉的帮派或团体也不是一个两个，我们插手也完全是偶然。

dataList.title:
Kurokumo Clan Captain
黑云会 副会长
dataList.content:
We were ordered by the Thumb to stand guard next to a black stele here, that's all.
我们……只是遵从拇指下达的指令，守卫着这里的黑色石碑。

dataList.title:
Kurokumo Clan Captain
黑云会 副会长
dataList.content:
Everyone was on edge because we were supposed to transport it elsewhere pretty soon...
马上它就必须要送去别的地方了，所以本来我们每个人就都很紧张……

dataList.title:
Kurokumo Clan Captain
黑云会 副会长
dataList.content:
... and that's when you Blade Lineage bastards appeared out of nowhere.
然后你们这群剑契组的又突然出现了。

dataList.title:
Blade Lineage
剑契组
dataList.content:
... Out of nowhere?
……突然出现？

dataList.title:
Blade Lineage
剑契组
dataList.content:
I see... So this is where our mentor has awakened.
这样啊……原来头领是在这里苏醒的啊。

dataList.title:
Kurokumo Clan Captain
黑云会 副会长
dataList.content:
You... Sounds like you know something that I don't...
你……知道些什么吗？

dataList.title:
Kurokumo Clan Captain
黑云会 副会长
dataList.content:
Can't say I've ever heard of a tech that could blip people into existence, just like that. Thought they were using a Singularity or something, tsk.
说到底，人怎么会那样突然间就蹦出来呢？我还以为他们使用了奇点。啧，然后……

dataList.title:
Kurokumo Clan Captain
黑云会 副会长
dataList.content:
Besides... the Blade Lineage never had a chance.
本来这也不是你们这群家伙能赢的战斗……

dataList.title:
Kurokumo Clan Captain
黑云会 副会长
dataList.content:
Our numerical advantage was insurmountable.
我们在数量上远远压过你们。

dataList.title:
Blade Lineage
剑契组
dataList.content:
... Of course.
……当然。

dataList.title:
Kurokumo Clan Captain
黑云会 副会长
dataList.content:
We had your friends cornered. We had no trouble cutting them down until there were but three of you left standing.
直到剑契组的家伙们还剩下3个能战斗的人为止，我们都还是完全没有问题的。

dataList.title:
Kurokumo Clan Captain
黑云会 副会长
dataList.content:
Then, all of a sudden, your boss' eye suddenly began to glow, and...
然后突然之间，你们头子的眼睛开始发光……

dataList.title:
Kurokumo Clan Captain
黑云会 副会长
dataList.content:
Haah, he cut down everyone around him. It was a one-sided slaughter.
啧，虽然很恼火……那个家伙把周围的所有人都砍倒了。应该说是单方面屠杀了。

dataList.title:
Blade Lineage
剑契组
dataList.content:
What...? Then...
欸……？那么……

dataList.title:
Kurokumo Clan Captain
黑云会 副会长
dataList.content:
You got that right. Blade Lineage, Kurokumo Clan, it didn't matter. He cut through *everyone*.
没错，剑契组也好，我们也罢，只要在他周围的，统统都被杀了。

dataList.title:
Kurokumo Clan Captain
黑云会 副会长
dataList.content:
So what the hell was I supposed to do? What were we supposed to do? I'm their Captain—the lives of my men are my responsibility. I had to save them somehow.
可是我们又能做什么呢。我作为副会长，必须保证不让手底下的人送命。

dataList.title:
Kurokumo Clan Captain
黑云会 副会长
dataList.content:
So I stayed behind to guard the door while my men guarded the entrance to this building. What other choice did I have?
结果就是我堵住了门……让手下的人在下面看着。

dataList.title:
Kurokumo Clan Captain
黑云会 副会长
dataList.content:
Haah... shit. Delivery deadline's coming up... I'm finished.
哈啊……可恶。这都是些什么鬼事。差不多也要到约定好的派送时间了……

dataList.title:
Kurokumo Clan Captain
黑云会 副会长
dataList.content:
This won't end with me having to cut off a finger or two... Dammit.
这可不是我切一两根手指就能了结的事情了吧……妈的。

dataList.title:
Blade Lineage
剑契组

Kurokumo Clan Captain
黑云会 副会长
dataList.content:
Guh?!
嗯？！

Aeng-du struck the back of Jun's neck with a swift precision and dropped him to the floor.
樱桃迅速地用手刀打在俊的脖子上，如此将他击倒。

Aeng-du?! That man had already been subdued! Wherefore didst thou—
樱桃小姐？！既然吾等已经活捉了他……

dataList.title:
Blade Lineage
剑契组
dataList.content:
I have merely put him to sleep. He would have caused us trouble had we attempted to enter that room while he was conscious.
如果我们要进去的话，他会变得很麻烦。我只是让他睡一会儿而已……

dataList.title:
Blade Lineage
剑契组
dataList.content:
I... must talk to the mentor. See him with my own eyes.
我……必须去见头领。

Have you gone deaf, lass? Your boss'll cut down anyone who gets too close.
你没听见吗？他可是把周围的所有人都砍倒了啊？

dataList.title:
Blade Lineage
剑契组
dataList.content:
No. That... cannot be.
那……不可能。

Dante. We can infer from what information we have gathered that...
但丁，结合话语内容来看……

<Yeah, I agree... There's a powerful aura coming from behind that door. I can sense it.>
<嗯，好像明白了……从那里面我能感受到很强大的气场。>

dataList.title:
Blade Lineage
剑契组
dataList.content:
Our mentor...
我们的头领……

Aeng-du's hands tremble as they wrap around the doorknob.
樱桃的手颤抖着握住了门把。

... We must prepare for battle.
……准备战斗。

dataList.title:
Blade Lineage
剑契组
dataList.content:
I know that mentor Bamboo-hatted Kim will do no such thing!
……金笠大人不可能会做出那种事的！

She slammed the door open...
门随着她说出的那句话一同打开了……
dataList.place:
Yong-jin Building 6F Office
龙进大楼 6层 办公室

dataList.content:
... only to come face-to-face with a Distortion.
而在其中，一个明显是扭曲的东西立于我们面前。
